parsed.name: 伪时钟时序调度组件
parsed.description: 用于实验时序编排的非物理软件组件。它负责汇总各时钟线输出的变化时刻，展开伪时钟节拍，处理触发与停止时间约束，并生成供下游实验设备使用的时序数据与代码。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component for experiment timing orchestration. It collects output change times across clock lines, expands pseudoclock ticks, handles trigger and stop-time constraints, and generates timing data and code for downstream lab devices.
